text:
maria-ml: Heads up — hitting a weird token ID creep after an HF->Redwood import of model `exemplar-3b`.

maria-ml: Symptoms: chat templates stop respecting <|bos|> and <|eos|> (responses get glued together), and generated tokens for system messages are off-by-a-few compared to HF runtime.

devon-eng: ugh. any repro steps / diff of the vocab?

maria-ml: quick repro attached inline: I loaded the HF tokenizer and our imported tokenizer and printed token ids for special tokens + first 5 vocabs.

maria-ml: ```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
# HF
hf = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('hf/exemplar-3b')
red = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/redwood/imports/exemplar-3b')
for t in ['<|bos|>','<|eos|>','<|pad|>','<|unk|>']:
    print('hf', t, hf.convert_tokens_to_ids(t))
    print('red', t, red.convert_tokens_to_ids(t))
print('hf first 5 ids', [hf.convert_tokens_to_ids(t) for t in hf.convert_tokens_to_ids(hf.convert_ids_to_tokens(range(5)))])
```

maria-ml: In our case HF reported BOS=1 EOS=2 PAD=0, but Redwood tokenizer returned BOS=2 EOS=3 PAD=0 — everything past the insertion point was +1.

sam-platform: Sounds like added_tokens got merged differently. Did the HF repo have an `added_tokens.json` with explicit ids?

maria-ml: HF had an `added_tokens.json` (list of strings) but no explicit ids. HF appends them at load time, order depends on vocab merge. Our importer attempted to maintain order but also merged `added_tokens` into vocab which caused a reindex where a placeholder (empty) token was inserted earlier. result: ID creep.

rosa-qe: can you paste the `added_tokens.json` snippet?

maria-ml: ```json
[
  "<|special_user|>",
  "<|system_notice|>"
]
```

devon-eng: ok. So HF appended 2 tokens at the end; our import ended up inserting them at index 1 due to a join bug. That inserts a shift for all subsequent ids. Which then breaks chat templates that expect fixed BOS/EOS ids.

sam-platform: Is this specific to quantized binaries? I remember quantizer packer was reordering vocab for alignment sometimes.

maria-ml: We saw it on both float and quantized imports, so bug is earlier in tokenizer/vocab merge step. Quantization just masks it.

devon-eng: Proposed quick fixes:
- Update importer to preserve explicit ids when provided in `tokenizer.json`/`added_tokens.json`.
- If explicit ids absent, append added_tokens to the end of the merged vocab (HF semantics) rather than inserting.
- Add a sanity check during import: compare hf tokenizer special token ids vs imported; if mismatch > 0, fail import and log diff.

sam-platform: +1 for the sanity check. We should also add an automatic remediation path: remap token IDs in the model/kv cache layer at load-time (temporary) and warn users.

rosa-qe: I'll write a unit test that loads a small mock vocab with `added_tokens.json` (no ids) and asserts id-preservation semantics. Also add an eval: run a trivial chat template and assert first token for assistant is BOS id.

maria-ml: Filed PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/importer/pull/432 — implements append semantics and raises on special token mismatch. CI currently failing on one test (edge case with empty-string special token).

ci-bot: CI pipeline for PR 432 started — job importer/test-vocab-merge queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon-eng: For existing imported models in prod, we need migration plan:
- Identify models where hf_special_ids != redwood_special_ids
- For each, either reimport with new importer or publish a remapping patch (server-side mapping table)
- Notify customers if SLA impact possible (unlikely but needs caution)

sam-platform: I'll add a script to scan model manifests for token id diffs and output a list. Want it to run as part of nightly audits.

maria-ml: Also: small follow-up — add a logging hook that prints the first 16 tokens of a model's output with token strings (not ids) during smoke tests so we catch glueing issues early.

rosa-qe: QA checklist item added. I'll run regression suite on the few recently onboarded models.

devon-eng: thanks all. If anyone finds more models with weird glueing, ping #eng-oncall and tag me @devon-eng. :thumbsup:
